author: nc1234
content: The current design puts the registration into a separate list in the state instead of in `Validator` container which is good. Because clients would not need to re-hash the validator list, but the registration list only. One annoying thing is to scan for duplicate XMSS key and duplicate VRF root and existing entry of validator per request.
